recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group specifically wants an additional inline hyperlink on "FHIR Document" despite the existing nearby documents.html#css link.
issue_request: FHIR-18486 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core narrative issue raised and applied for STU3. It asked to clarify that authoring systems cannot specify a CSS stylesheet directly except when the stylesheet is included in a FHIR Document, and to point readers to the document CSS rules.
initial_application: Commit c23fe08dc092b9483bf93d0143cab83385182a18 ("GF#18486 - clarify CSS rules") added the requested exception text to source/narrative.html. The current source still contains that exception.
additional_context: source/narrative.html and source/documents.html are current build-scope pages through source/fhir.ini, source/hierarchy.xml, and publish.ini. The narrative CSS section already points to documents.html#css for additional document styling rules, and the document CSS section describes Bundle stylesheet links and safety constraints. Later nearby CSS edits for FHIR-49732 and FHIR-18488 preserved the FHIR-18486 exception. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no conflicting or superseding context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current specification already conveys the approved exception and provides the relevant document CSS cross-link; adding another direct hyperlink on the words "FHIR Document" would be optional navigation polish rather than a necessary source correction.

related_jiras.note: Later edited the same narrative CSS section for nolist/unlist styling without changing the FHIR Document stylesheet exception.
